ModMetaData.name: Housebroken - Pickle other filth part (after)
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Development only, never published. Adds a second StatPart to the FilthRate stat (a constant x1.5 by age, the vanilla StatPart_Age) so that Housebroken can be tested beside another mod that touches the same stat, loaded after it.
